annotations.title: Review market noise and evidence quality

description: Build a source-aware review queue for caller-supplied market series at an explicit UTC as_of cutoff, checking moves, volatility, missing data and measurement coverage. Use when provenance and freshness matter; use did_it_change for an unannotated numeric history or spectral_assessment for correlation structure across an aligned panel. Prices become log returns; other kinds retain their supplied values and units. Defaults require 30 baseline + 3 recent derived points (34 contiguous price observations, 33 for other kinds). Returns status (assessed, partial or insufficient_visibility), per-series status/reasons/diagnostics, attention_queue, visibility_gaps, related_movements and coverage. Nonpermitted rights, stale/future observations or inadequate history remain explicit gaps; no sources are fetched or filled. Duplicate ids, unordered timestamps and nonpositive prices are errors. Read limits and source clocks before interpreting a departure: review priority is neither a trading signal nor a calibrated probability.

as_of.description: UTC decision-time cutoff for source freshness and availability checks; for example 2026-01-01T12:00:00Z. Future observations are not silently included.

policy.description: Optional review thresholds; omitted fields use the documented defaults. Policies do not create statistical or trading guarantees.

baseline_points.description: Number of earlier transformed observations in the baseline window; default 30. Total required transformed history is baseline_points + recent_points.

coverage_drop_fraction.description: Absolute fractional change in median measurement coverage that prompts review, including increases; default 0.2 means 20%. Applies only to supplied sample_size values.

move_threshold.description: Departure threshold in baseline robust-spread units (1.4826 times median absolute deviation); default 3.0. This is a review threshold, not a significance level.

recent_points.description: Number of latest transformed observations compared with the baseline; default 3. Persistence requires at least two qualifying readings, so a one-point window cannot establish persistence.

volatility_ratio.description: Recent-to-baseline robust-spread ratio that flags volatility expansion; default 3.0. A constant baseline followed by positive spread is also flagged.

series.description: Up to 32 caller-supplied series to assess independently, with unique ids and source/clock metadata. An empty list returns insufficient_visibility.

group.description: Optional caller-defined grouping label for review queues; defaults to this series id. It does not certify independence or comparability.

id.description: Unique series identifier within this request, used in results and cross-series relationships.

kind.description: Measurement type. Both assessment tools convert price to log returns. market_assessment keeps other values unchanged; spectral_assessment keeps return values and first-differences level, spread, rate and count.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum allowed age in seconds of the last observation relative to as_of. Older data remains insufficient_visibility; choose an appropriate cadence-specific limit.

max_gap_seconds.description: Optional largest allowed time gap in seconds between observations. A larger gap restarts the contiguous tail. If omitted, calendar gap policy is unknown and a warning is returned.

observations.description: Zero to 2048 observations in strictly increasing UTC order. Empty or inadequate histories return visibility gaps; null values and declared time gaps are preserved, never interpolated.

available_at.description: UTC time the observation became available to the caller. A time before observed_at becomes an availability_precedes_observation visibility gap; after as_of becomes not_yet_available. Omission is retained as incomplete availability history.

observed_at.description: Time represented by this observation, in UTC. Timestamps within a series must be unique and strictly increasing.

sample_size.description: Positive measurement-coverage denominator for this observation, or null when missing. This is not trading volume. Omit if coverage is not supplied; zero is invalid.

value.description: Finite measurement in the declared series unit. Prices must be positive and counts nonnegative. Use null for missing data; it breaks the contiguous analysis window and is never filled.

source.description: Source identity, optional attribution URL and declared usage rights. All are caller-supplied, not attestations.

id.description: Caller-defined source identifier retained in results, for example synthetic-demo or a licensed provider name.

rights.description: Caller's source-use declaration. Only permitted permits numerical assessment; unknown and restricted remain explicit visibility gaps. The server does not grant or verify rights.

url.description: Optional source or evidence URL retained for attribution; no URL is fetched or independently verified.

unit.description: Consistent measurement unit for all observations, for example USD, decimal_return, basis_points or count. No currency conversion, percent conversion or economic comparability is inferred.

name: market_assessment

anyOf.description: Existing tool-error payload; no successful result fields are implied.

error.description: Validation or computation failure message; inspect MCP isError or the HTTP status.

outputSchema.description: Market attention and explicit source/coverage gaps; no absent evidence is replaced by zero. Tool errors retain the separate error-message shape.

attention_queue.description: Review/watch series sorted by priority then id.

coverage.description: Coverage of only the supplied set.

complete_for_supplied_series.description: Nonempty supplied set with no visibility gaps.

error.description: Validation or computation failure message; inspect MCP isError or the HTTP status.

policy_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized submitted request or applied policy.

related_movements.description: Relationships with absolute correlation at least 0.85.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized submitted request or applied policy.

series.description: All supplied series in input order.

items.description: Every supplied series is retained, including rejected sources and missing histories.

anyOf.description: Cutoff minus last observation timestamp in seconds; may be negative for future data.

age_seconds.description: Cutoff minus last observation timestamp in seconds; may be negative for future data. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

analyzed_points.description: Points actually used; omitted for insufficient visibility.

analyzed_unit.description: log_return for prices, otherwise the declared unit.

as_published_history_verified.description: Caller timestamps do not verify historical availability.

availability_timestamps_complete.description: Every supplied observation declares availability and the series is nonempty.

anyOf.description: Last supplied availability timestamp, if present.

available_at.description: Last supplied availability timestamp, if present. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

anyOf.description: Computed only for source-eligible series with sufficient contiguous history.

baseline_robust_spread.description: Baseline MAD times 1.4826 in analyzed units.

anyOf.description: Recent minus baseline median denominator divided by baseline.

relative_change.description: Recent minus baseline median denominator divided by baseline. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

lag_one_correlation.description: Lag-one correlation, when estimable. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

latest_change.description: Latest minus baseline median in analyzed units.

anyOf.description: Latest change in baseline robust-spread units.

latest_robust_departure.description: Latest change in baseline robust-spread units. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

median_change.description: Recent minus baseline median in analyzed units.

monitor.description: Descriptive monitor of the analyzed window.

change_points.description: Alarm positions in the analyzed window.

guarantee.description: No statistical or market-performance guarantee is made.

statistic.description: Raw monitoring statistic, not an e-value.

persistence_points.description: Recent readings with a supported same-direction departure.

recent_robust_spread.description: Recent MAD times 1.4826 in analyzed units.

representation_tolerance.description: Log-price arithmetic tolerance in analyzed units, zero for direct measurements.

anyOf.description: Median change in baseline robust-spread units.

robust_departure.description: Median change in baseline robust-spread units. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

anyOf.description: Recent/baseline robust spread; null at zero baseline spread.

volatility_ratio.description: Recent/baseline robust spread; null at zero baseline spread. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

diagnostics.description: Computed only for source-eligible series with sufficient contiguous history. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

group.description: Declared group, defaulting to series id.

guarantee.description: No statistical or market-performance guarantee is made.

anyOf.description: Last supplied observation timestamp; null for no observations.

observed_at.description: Last supplied observation timestamp; null for no observations. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

anyOf.description: Review=2, watch=1, no supported departure=0; null when ineligible.

priority.description: Review=2, watch=1, no supported departure=0; null when ineligible. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

id.description: Caller-defined source identifier retained in results, for example synthetic-demo or a licensed provider name.

rights.description: Caller's source-use declaration. Only permitted permits numerical assessment; unknown and restricted remain explicit visibility gaps. The server does not grant or verify rights.

url.description: Optional source or evidence URL retained for attribution; no URL is fetched or independently verified.

transform.description: price becomes log_return; all other kinds use identity.

validity.description: Descriptive assessment, not a probability or statistical certificate.
